grpc.marshalling: Unary RPCs use Orleans serializers through LatticeTenantAdminGrpcMarshallers.

metadata.name: authorization

metadata.name: lattice-active-tenant

auth.decision: RequireAuthorization defaults true; DenyTenantAdminApiAuthorizer denies until opt-in; GetAuthScheme and self-service methods are exempt and defer to facade scoping.

retry.policy: Safe to retry. The purge is accept-then-poll: the first call records it in progress and hands the shard walk to a background timer, then waits a bounded time; a call while the purge runs, or after it completed, returns the current status without error, so after an ambiguous failure or a return with PurgeInProgress still true, read the deletion status or simply call again.

idempotency.basis: Accepting a purge that is already running or complete changes nothing and returns its status; the background walk resumes from its last durably recorded shard after a restart.

concurrency.rule: The target id is composed as t/{tenantId}/{name} under the ambient active tenant; no parameter can name another tenant tree.

retry.policy: Retry is safe after a partial recovery failure, but a retry after a completed recovery fails with InvalidOperationException because the tree is no longer deleted.

idempotency.basis: Recovery keeps the deletion record until idempotent shard unmark and reseed complete, but after success the cleared deletion record makes a repeated call throw InvalidOperationException.

concurrency.rule: The target id is composed as t/{tenantId}/{name} under the ambient active tenant; no parameter can name another tenant tree.
